description: Comprehensive monitoring dashboard for ISC Kea DHCP4 servers in active/active HA mode. Tracks lease utilization, DHCP packet flow (DORA), per-subnet capacity, HA load distribution, and error conditions.

panels.description: Total active DHCP leases across all subnets and instances
panels.title: Total Active Leases

panels.description: Total DHCP pool capacity across all subnets
panels.title: Total Pool Capacity

panels.description: Overall DHCP address pool utilization percentage

targets.expr: sum(max by (subnet) (kea_dhcp4_addresses_assigned_total{pool="", instance=~"$instance", subnet=~"$subnet"})) / sum(max by (subnet) (kea_dhcp4_addresses_total{pool="", instance=~"$instance", subnet=~"$subnet"})) * 100

panels.title: Overall Utilization

panels.description: DHCP REQUEST packets per second across all instances
panels.title: DHCP Requests/s

panels.description: DHCP DISCOVER packets per second — clients seeking a server
panels.title: Discovers/s

panels.description: DHCP ACK packets per second — successful lease grants
panels.title: ACKs/s

panels.description: DHCP NAK packets per second — lease request rejections. Should be 0.
panels.title: NAKs/s

panels.description: DHCPDECLINE received: a client found the offered address already in use (IP conflict).
panels.title: Declines/s

panels.description: Address pool utilization percentage per subnet. Green <70%, Yellow <85%, Red >=85%.

targets.expr: max by (subnet) (kea_dhcp4_addresses_assigned_total{pool="", instance=~"$instance", subnet=~"$subnet"}) / max by (subnet) (kea_dhcp4_addresses_total{pool="", instance=~"$instance", subnet=~"$subnet"}) * 100

panels.title: Subnet Utilization %

panels.description: Active lease count per subnet over time
panels.title: Active Leases by Subnet

panels.description: Per-subnet pool capacity details: assigned leases, total capacity, utilization %, and declined addresses

targets.expr: max by (subnet) (kea_dhcp4_addresses_assigned_total{pool="", instance=~"$instance", subnet=~"$subnet"}) / max by (subnet) (kea_dhcp4_addresses_total{pool="", instance=~"$instance", subnet=~"$subnet"}) * 100

panels.title: Pool Capacity Table

panels.description: DHCP DORA flow: Discover, Offer, Request, ACK packet rates over time
panels.title: DHCP Packet Flow (DORA)

panels.description: DHCP error packet rates: NAK, Decline, and Dropped packets
panels.title: DHCP Errors

panels.description: Total DHCP packets per instance — shows HA load distribution between dns-0 and dns-1
panels.title: Packets by Instance

panels.description: Active leases per subnet over time with subnet color coding
panels.title: Lease Activity by Subnet

panels.description: Rate of expired leases being reclaimed per subnet
panels.title: Reclaimed Leases/s

panels.description: Rate of declined addresses per subnet — indicates IP conflicts or duplicate detection
panels.title: Declined Addresses/s

panels.description: DHCP packet distribution between dns-0 and dns-1 — should be approximately 50/50 in HA load-balancing mode
panels.title: HA Load Distribution

panels.description: Reservation conflicts per subnet — indicates misconfigured or duplicate reservations. Should be 0.
panels.title: Reservation Conflicts/s

panels.description: DHCPNAK packets sent per instance — proxy for allocation failures (Kea exposes no allocations-failed counter and packets are not labeled per-subnet). Indicates lease confirmation rejections / pool exhaustion.
panels.title: NAKs/s by instance

title: Kea DHCP4 - DHCP Server
